metadata.description: Private GitHub Copilot plugin marketplace for development workflow skills

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: Full product-development lifecycle workflow skills for GitHub Copilot CLI: idea → create-vi → create-ard → specify → design → epics → implement → document → release-notes → ready, plus vuln (CVE remediation), upgrade (dependency upgrades), update-vi (VI refresh), api-guideline-reviewer, guideline-reviewer, docs-profile, feedback, and prompt utilities. Strong-tier model routing (Opus 5/4.8/4.7/4.6 or GPT-5.6/5.5), branch management, dispatched Opus/GPT-5.6 review sub-agents, and automated maintenance. document: now grounds space-constrained runs on the counterpart space's existing docs as read-only reference. release-notes: now routes each note to its destination (breaking-changes / feature-updates / fixes), shapes the Summary per destination, and sources the {{#context}} label from the imported VI. When $DOCS_PATH is set, idea/create-vi/update-vi/create-ard/specify/epics/release-notes ground on the product's existing shipped documentation as read-only reference (docs-grounder; qmd with keyword + git-grep fallback). When $VAULT_PATH resolves to a tracked vault, idea/create-vi also ground on vault prior art — tracked initiatives that cover, precede, parallel, or are rewritten by the new work (vault-prior-art-finder; no index, no consent gate). idea: now optionally grounds against mounted code with --ground-code — a broad code-scanner fan-out followed by a seeded narrow round for inconclusive themes (model-routing.md §8.5) — writing findings to idea.md's optional Feasibility grounding section with file:line citations; off by default, never auto-triggered. document: now proposes deprecation/announcement pages via a profiled announcement_pages block, writes rendered pages with no source provenance (traceability lives in the commit and run handoff), reviews callout scope and sibling component-pattern reuse, folds new-and-stale screenshot handling into one always-running image phase, and defers Phase 8's copilot-instructions.md/knowledge-base maintenance edits to an apply step that runs only after the docs commit is sealed. 20 user-facing skills + 33 sub-agents.

plugins.name: dt-style-guide
plugins.description: Dynatrace corporate style guide checker and writing-aid plugin. Enforces terminology, trademarks, voice/tone, grammar, formatting, and inclusive-language rules from styleguide.dynatrace.com. Includes dt-review-pr (review PR doc changes), dt-review-docs (review files/directories with optional --fix), dt-style-refresh (update vendored rules), a dt-style-rules skill, two dispatched sub-agents (dt-style-checker, dt-doc-fixer), and eight vendored reference docs. Acts as a fallback for dev-workflows when no repo-configured prose linter is available.

plugins.name: obsidian-llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki pattern for an active Obsidian vault. Eleven skills (wiki-init, wiki-ingest, wiki-scan, wiki-query, wiki-save, wiki-lint, wiki-hot, wiki-tags-refresh, wiki-schema, wiki-task, wiki-tasks-extract) for ingesting, querying, saving, linting, and managing a persistent wiki compiled from meetings, projects, and daily notes. Includes task management: create individual tasks and batch-extract tasks from wiki content.

plugins.name: acli
plugins.description: Atlassian CLI (acli) reference skill for Jira and Confluence: JQL search, work items, comments, links, attachments, watchers, projects, sprints, boards, filters, and Confluence spaces, pages and blog posts. Adds container-friendly authentication and a destructive-operation policy. Requires the acli binary on PATH.
